Nina: Quick sprint: finalize hosted/dedicated/private landing copy + launch posts + webinar hooks. Need final variants by EOD Fri. Main asks: 1) hero lines per mode 2) 3 launch post angles 3) webinar CTA and routing for inbound leads. Who can own sections?
Ari: I'll take hero lines for Hosted and Dedicated. Can we keep Private focused on compliance/security?
Diego: I'll draft the 3 launch post angles. Prefer: cost/perf story, reliability story, enterprise control story.
Jordan: For webinar routing — we should tag attendees by use-case in the form (hosted/dedicated/private) and route to different follow-up sequences. I can wire pieces with Zapier and HubSpot.
Lily: I'll mock up hero options, need preferred copy lengths (long/short).
Nina: @Jordan yup. Diego, can you also write 3 subject lines? Ari can we keep hero variants under 8 words for hero and 1-line subhead?
Ari: Yep. Drafts below:
Hosted hero: "Instant API for production LLMs" — subhead "Low-latency, managed inference. Start in minutes."
Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput" — subhead "Commit to capacity, avoid spikes."
Private hero: "Private deployment with enterprise controls" — subhead "VPC, KMS, and audit logs — for regulated workloads."
Diego: Launch post angles:
1) "Latency & cost benchmarks" (attach micro-bench)
2) "Reliability at scale" (SLA stories)
3) "Compliance-first private deployments" (customer quote)
Subjects: a) "Benchmark: 3x lower inference cost" b) "Keeping your app online during peak" c) "Private deployments — rollout & webinar"
Jordan: For routing: form fields: company size, primary use-case (chat/generation/embeddings), deployment interest (hosted/dedicated/private). If private selected, tag enterprise-sdr queue; dedicated -> commit queue; hosted -> self-serve nurture. I'll map UTMs too.
Lily: mock link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (will attach comps). Also prefer hero typographic treatment A over B. Will attach comps tomorrow.
Sam: Quick check — do we need to update pricing page for Dedicated commit mention? Legal ok with "commit" wording?
Nina: Sam liaise with Legal. Also Diego can we get a micro-benchmark image from eng for post 1? @eng-ml ping.
Diego: I'll ping eng-ml now. @Ari I'll need short 2-line copy for social cards.
Ari: Social card lines: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" and "Scale inference without surprises".
Jordan: I'll export three landing variants and configure routes: /hosted?utm=launch, /dedicated?utm=launch, /private?utm=launch. Webinar signup will append ?source=webinar.
Nina: Plan: Fri EOD final copy, Mon morning launch posts and email, Wed webinar. Everyone OK?
Ari: :thumbsup:
Diego: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Lily: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
